fact: ICASEES published the education statistical yearbook (fondamental 1 and non-formal education) from the 2022 school-census campaign covering 2020/2021 and 2021/2022, after production had stopped since 2019, with the 2016-2019 series of four yearbooks produced earlier.
title: Annuaire Statistique, Fondamental 1, Alphabétisation et Education de base non formelle - 2021-2022
